Where each kind of finding lands, so the next machine starts from a better pipeline.
Real cases from November 2026: S3 drum too flat, F3 belts, a pinion cutting the ring gear, the GIF strobe.
Out of scope: the content of the rules themselves (see SKILL.md and docs/MACHINE-PIPELINE.md).
